subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when placed from left to right in the blanks, will complete the letter series.

_B_T F H B N_F I_N T F_B N T F
solution:
Given : _B_T F H B N_F I_N T F_B N T F 

By checking options :

 
• G N T B J → __**G**__B__**N**__T F H B N__**T**__F I__**B**__N T F__**J**__B N T F → (It follows the pattern of : [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/126b01444ed771ec751e1795245341f8ee4966f8861b7bc98b8a0ea34c57b98e.png] )
 
• G T N J B → __G__B__T__T F H B N__N__F I__J__N T F__B__B N T F → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)
 
• G J N T B → __G__B__J__T F H B N__N__F I__T__N T F__B__B N T F → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)
 
• G B N T B → __G__B__B__T F H B N__N__F I__T__N T F__B__B N T F → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)

⇒Option - (1) gives the pattern of "__G__B__N__T F - H B N__T__F - I__B__N T F - __J__B N T F"

Hence, "**G N T B J**" is the correct answer.
